backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ToolShare backend, defining types (UserProfile, ToolListing, RentalRequest, ChatMessage) and state management for profiles, tools, rentals, and chats with access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report identifying a single high-confidence feature fix for the CustomMapView component, covering tile fetching, Web Mercator projection, marker positioning, and viewport bounds stability across zoom levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each page, component, hook, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite-based frontend, mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/README.md: Minimal README for the ToolShare frontend, identifying it as a community tool-sharing platform built on the Internet Computer with a Getting Started section placeholder.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (browse, listings, rentals, messaging, profile, community map) and wraps the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity authentication, showing loading state during login and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth guard component that renders a login prompt card when the user is unauthenticated, otherwise renders its children.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Community map panel combining a CustomMapView with a member sidebar list, supporting member selection to display an info card overlay and filtering members to those with coordinates.
frontend/src/components/community/Custom: A custom tile-based interactive map component that renders community member markers, supports pan/zoom (including cursor-anchored zoom), and auto-fits the viewport to member locations.
Renders a teardrop-shaped SVG map pin for a community member, showing their avatar or initials, with color and size variations for selected/current-user states.
frontend/src/components/community/SetCoo: A dialog form that geocodes a user-entered address via Nominatim and saves the resulting coordinates to the user's profile for map placement.
frontend/src/components/landing/Floating: A canvas-based animation layer that renders drifting 3D-style floating objects (orbs, rings, faceted shapes, tori) with parallax and wobble effects for the landing page background.
frontend/src/components/landing/Interact: A wrapper component that applies a 3D perspective tilt effect on mouse movement, with a radial highlight overlay, disabled for touch devices and reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingI: A thin wrapper around an HTML img element with lazy loading defaults and an accessibility warning if alt text is missing.
A landing page section displaying a two-column layout with marketing copy, stat cards, and a hero illustration image.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Sticky top navigation header with the ToolShare logo, responsive nav links (shown based on auth state), a login button or profile menu, and a mobile slide-out sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Full-page layout wrapper that composes AppHeader, a flex-growing main content area, and AppFooter.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: Reusable page-level heading component that renders a title, optional subtitle, and optional action buttons in a flex row.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Simple container wrapper that applies consistent horizontal padding and vertical spacing to page content.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: Filter bar card for the browse page exposing search text, category, sort order, min/max price, and available-only toggle controls via controlled props.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: Camera UI panel that starts the device camera on mount, shows a live video preview, and emits a JPEG data URL on capture; handles unsupported/error states with alerts.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Responsive grid of tool listing cards, each showing a photo (with fallback icon), title, category badge, description, location, and price; links to the individual listing page.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: Dropdown menu rendered only for the listing owner, providing Edit Listing navigation and a toggle-availability action that calls the editToolListing mutation.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: Form field for managing a list of tool photos, supporting URL entry, removal, and camera capture via a dialog-hosted CameraCapturePanel.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays the active conversation panel for a selected rental, showing tool info, rental dates, status badge, and the chat panel. Falls back to an empty state prompt when no rental is selected.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Renders a scrollable list of rental conversations, each showing tool title, other user's name/role, and rental status badge, with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: A styled navigation link component wrapping TanStack Router's Link with active/inactive color classes.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Dropdown menu component showing the authenticated user's avatar, display name, and options to view their profile or log out.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to enter their display name, contact info, location, and address to create their profile.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: Chat panel for a rental that loads and displays messages, distinguishes own vs. other messages visually, and allows sending new messages via textarea with Enter key support.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: Form component for submitting a rental request for a tool, with date pickers for start/end dates, validation, and navigation to the rentals page on success.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Renders action buttons (Approve/Decline, Cancel, Complete) for a rental based on the current status and whether the user is the owner or renter, using confirmation dialogs and a status update mutation.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: Displays a centered card with an icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an empty state.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: Displays a destructive-styled card with an alert icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an error state.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: Renders a centered spinner with an optional message to indicate a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via AuthClient, exposed through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTiles.ts: Calculates the set of map tiles and their pixel positions needed to fill a viewport given a center coordinate and zoom level, using Web Mercator projection with CartoDB tile URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Manages map pan and zoom state with pointer drag handling and zoom controls, converting pixel deltas to lat/lng offsets using Web Mercator math.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Provides simple zoom state management with zoom in/out, reset, and mouse wheel handler functions within configurable min/max bounds.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallaxMotion.ts: Tracks mouse position and scroll offset to produce parallax motion values, respecting the user's reduced-motion preference.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Returns a boolean indicating whether the user has requested reduced motion via the OS/browser media query, updating reactively on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, chat messages, and community map profiles. Wraps queries and mutations with cache invalidation logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebGLSupport.ts: Custom hook that detects WebGL support by attempting to create a canvas context, returning isSupported, isChecking, and error state.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind with CSS custom properties defining light/dark theme color tokens, plus utility classes for 3D transforms, landing page texture background, and reduced-motion overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page component for browsing tool listings with filter/search state (text, category, price range, availability, sort) passed to useSearchTools and rendered via BrowseFiltersBar and ListingsGrid.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Page that displays a map of community members using their stored coordinates; requires authentication and allows users to add or update their location via SetCoordinatesDialog.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero section, how-it-works steps, feature cards, and calls-to-action for browsing tools or listing equipment, using interactive tilt and floating object components.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single tool listing showing photos, category, condition, pricing, and location, with owner-specific actions and a rental request form for authenticated non-owners.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: A form page for creating or editing a tool listing, supporting both 'create' and 'edit' modes with fields for title, category, description, condition, pricing, location, availability, and photos.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Displays a messaging interface showing conversations tied to the user's rentals, with a conversations list and an active conversation panel side by side.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Shows a grid of rental requests and bookings made by the current user, with status badges, date ranges, and action buttons for each rental.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's tool listings along with alerts for pending rental requests and active rentals, with a button to add new tools.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: A profile page that lets the authenticated user view and edit their display name, contact info, location, profile picture, and address, with support for an 'edit' URL parameter to pre-open edit mode.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific rental including tool details, dates, cost, status, and a chat panel, with role-aware actions for the owner and renter.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Displays incoming rental requests for the authenticated user's tools, rendering each request as a card with status badge, date range, and action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Exports a single async utility function that converts a File object to a base64 data URL string using FileReader.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides utilities for equirectangular (flat) geo-to-screen projection, coordinate validation, and coordinate string parsing.
frontend/src/utils/globeProjection.ts: Provides Three.js-based utilities for converting lat/lon to a 3D Vector3 on a sphere, plus coordinate validation and parsing helpers.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Exports date/time formatting functions for rental timestamps (bigint nanoseconds), including short date, long date, chat timestamp, and rental duration calculation.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Defines color and label mappings for all RentalStatus enum values and exports helper functions to retrieve them.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Exports two functions that format a bigint join timestamp into a human-readable time-on-app duration string and a formatted join date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations for accordion and floating effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking version, known issues, and a single existing feature request to fix zoom-related failures in the CustomMapView component.
